name: Quantification

subjectOf.text: A central methodological obstacle for quantum economics is that complex social phenomena such as social power and mental energy resist reduction to exact equations, which leaves the framework without a consistent set of units for subjective forces.
subjectOf.abstract: Another challenge is the difficulty in quantifying and reducing complex social phenomena, such as social power or mental energy, to exact equations.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878

subjectOf.text: Tokens solve the quantification problem in quantum economics by serving as measurable units of value and governance: token denominated voting power in a DAO makes social influence and decision making power countable, supplying the consistent set of units the framework lacked.
subjectOf.abstract: Tokenomics offers a practical solution through the use of tokens as quantifiable units of value and governance.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878
scope_conditions: token based systems with on chain governance such as DAOs
